title: Pipeline messages
description: Bodies of the Service Bus messages between the pipeline's services (ADR-0005). Strict: a sender's tests reject any field not listed here. Receivers read only the fields they know.

envelope.description: Fields of every message. userId is the oid of the person (ADR-0010); docId and verId are UUIDv7 made by the API (ADR-0006).

ExtractRequested.description: Queue extract, from the checker (or the API's sweeper and U9) to the extractor. The pages are in clean/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.zip.

Extracted.description: Queue status, from the extractor to the API. The results are in text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json (claim check).

Failed.description: Queue status, from the checker or the extractor to the API. timeout is never sent: the API's sweeper sets it.
